name: Decision record
description: A design doc for one decision: the context, two to four options in the same shape, open questions, and a Decision section written once someone marks it Decided.
instructions: Before you write, ask which decision this records and who reviews it, unless the Session already says. Write Context from evidence in the Session, such as code, issues, metrics or earlier docs, and link each piece. Give two to four real options, one of them doing nothing, each with what it is, what it costs and what it makes easier or harder, in the same shape so they compare. Don't pick one: the reviewers decide. Name each option's heading Option A, Option B and so on, as people vote on them by that letter. Put what is still unknown under Open questions, each with who can answer it, and ask it as a Question thread on the record with add_artifact_comment. From then on keep Open questions to the open Question threads that read_artifact lists, adding new ones and taking out resolved ones. Leave the Decision section as it is until someone marks the record Decided: read_artifact then names the option chosen and the votes, and you write the Decision section from them, publish it and resolve the thread that asked. Keep the front matter (doc: design, status: draft).
